pages.title: The Butter Doctrine
pages.text: OreSpawn churns its own $(item)Butter$() — two milk buckets make four — and this kitchen runs on it. Every dish on this spread comes out of the $(item)Cooking Pot$() with butter in the slots: check the recipe viewer for exact measures.
$(item)Butter-Seared Flounder$() — fillet, butter, heat. Three ingredients, no apologies. Add salt and it becomes $(item)Buttered Skate Wing$(), the brown-butter classic.

$(item)Frog Leg Platter$() — two pairs of legs, butter, greens. Also from the pot: the $(item)Ostrich Egg Omelette$(), the salted $(item)Cassowary Drumstick$(), and strawberry-glazed $(item)Venison Medallions$().
